stops.name: Osaka

activities.name: Osaka walking tour

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Ten days, three cities and simple hotels in the right places. The money goes on the trains and the days out instead.
expert.tip: Hiroshima deserves two nights, not one. The park in the early morning before the coaches arrive is the reason to stay over.

summary: Ten days on a simpler budget: three nights in Tokyo with a city tour and Mount Fuji, two in Hiroshima for the Peace Memorial Park and Miyajima, then four in Osaka with Kyoto, Nara, a walking tour and a free day.
included: Included: 9 nights accommodation with breakfast on the first six mornings; bullet train between Tokyo, Hiroshima and Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip; Hiroshima and Miyajima full day tour; Kyoto and Nara day trip; Osaka half day walking tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
